pli-tv-bi-vb-pc41:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc41:1.2: tena kho pana samayena rañño Pasenadikosalassa uyyāne cittāgāre paṭibhānacittaṃ kataṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc41:1.6: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo cittāgāraṃ dassanāya gacchissanti seyyathāpi gihikāmabhoginiyo 'ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc41:1.7: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc41:1.9: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo cittāgāraṃ dassanāya gacchissantīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc41:1.10: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo . . . gacchantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc41:1.13: hi nāma bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo . . . gacchissanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc41:1.16.1: yā pana bhikkhunī rājāgāraṃ vā cittāgāraṃ vā ārāmaṃ vā uyyānaṃ vā pokkharaṇiṃ vā dassanāya gaccheyya, pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc41:2.1.6: yattha katthaci rañño kīḷituṃ ramituṃ kataṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc41:2.1.8: yattha katthaci manussānaṃ kīḷituṃ ramituṃ kataṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc41:2.1.10: yattha katthaci manussānaṃ kīḷituṃ ramituṃ kato hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc41:2.1.12: yattha katthaci manussānaṃ kīḷituṃ ramituṃ kataṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc41:2.1.14: yattha katthaci manussānaṃ kīḷituṃ ramituṃ katā hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc41:2.1.17: dassanupacāraṃ vijahitvā punappunaṃ passati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc41:2.1.20: dassanupacāram vijahitvā punappunaṃ passati, āpatti pācittiyassa. ||1||
